contracts.commit_point: The sandboxed subprocess launch: subprocess.run in launch_target_adaptation_agent (agent_workspace.py:900-908) and subprocess.Popen in launch_target_adaptation_agent_async (agent_workspace.py:989-997).
contracts.declared_mechanism: Profile rules '(deny file-write* (subpath ...))' for existing readonly mounts and paired '(deny file-read*'/'(deny file-write*' rules for existing protected paths (agent_workspace.py:324-330), plus OS-level chmod hardening of both mounts via _make_readonly_tree before launch (agent_workspace.py:252-260, applied at 814-815).
contracts.forbidden_condition: file-read* or file-write* operations by the agent process under any protected subpath, and file-write* operations under attempt readonly_inputs/ or readonly_source/, while the sandbox profile is attached to the agent session.
pending_binding_information: Exact composition of the default protected set depends on runtime workspace depth and repository layout (agent_workspace.py:282-297); per-deployment coverage is not fixed by supplied source.
contracts.protected_operation: Filesystem access performed by the target-adaptation agent process during its session, launched sandboxed from the attempt workspace.
contracts.protected_resource: Protected Core/holdout paths: default protected siblings beneath the repository root and the attempt workspace's fifth-level parent (agent_workspace.py:282-297); operator-supplied protected_paths outside the attempt, which the compile command sets to the target path, run snapshots, and reference cache/usage-ledger paths (cli.py:498-502); and the read-only mounts readonly_inputs/ (agent_workspace.py:622-667) and readonly_source/ (provisioned at cli.py:471-480).
contracts.protection_obligation: The launched target-adaptation agent must be denied filesystem reads and writes under protected Core/holdout paths and denied writes under the readonly_inputs/ and readonly_source/ mounts, via the same generated sandbox-exec profile attached at agent launch.
scope_limits: Reads of readonly_inputs/ and readonly_source/ remain allowed; only writes are denied for the readonly mounts (agent_workspace.py:324-326).
Deny rules are emitted only for protected/readonly paths that exist at profile generation time (agent_workspace.py:325, 328).
Default-allow profile: filesystem locations outside the deny set remain accessible to the agent (agent_workspace.py:320).

_default_protected_paths additionally refuses launch when the resolved agent command lives inside protected Core paths (agent_workspace.py:292-296); compile preflight performs an analogous check (cli.py:824-841).
Denial enforcement is external sandbox-exec behavior; supplied source evidences rule generation and attachment only.

contracts.forbidden_condition: Launching the target-adaptation agent when reference cost >= max_cost (RuntimeError 'compile reference cost exhausted --max-cost before agent launch; agent was not started'), proceeding after a snapshot-phase ReferenceBudgetExhausted, or running the final test after the interactive loop reports stop_reason 'budget_exhausted'.
pending_binding_information: Whether the interactive compile loop can restart or extend the agent session under remaining budget is not determinable from supplied source.
contracts.protected_operation: Target-adaptation agent launch within the compile run (launch_target_adaptation_agent_async) and the post-loop final test evaluation.
contracts.protected_resource: The compile --max-cost reference budget at the agent-launch and final-test boundaries.
contracts.protection_obligation: The compile command must not launch the target-adaptation agent, and must not run the final test, once compile reference spend has reached --max-cost.
scope_limits: The gate compares cost snapshots at compile-command checkpoints; mid-session spend control depends on the interactive loop (module not supplied).
The gate is inert when --max-cost is omitted (cli.py:669); --max-cost 0 is rejected earlier as leaving no budget for the required reference probe (cli.py:359-362).
The gate is inline preflight in the compile command flow, not a framework-registered callback.

contracts.commit_point: sys.addaudithook(_audit) registration at worker start (portable_sandbox.py:148), active before the worker command is run via exec/runpy (portable_sandbox.py:150-166); from that point each guarded event during worker execution is denied by the hook.
contracts.declared_mechanism: build_python_sandbox_command embeds allowed/denied roots in a JSON config and returns [sys.executable, -c, <runner>, <config>] (portable_sandbox.py:190-212); the runner registers sys.addaudithook(_audit) (portable_sandbox.py:148) whose _check_read/_check_write raise PermissionError (portable_sandbox.py:96-113) and which denies socket/subprocess events (portable_sandbox.py:144-145).
contracts.forbidden_condition: Inside the worker interpreter: open reads outside allowed_read_roots/system roots or inside denied_read_roots; writes outside allowed_write_roots or inside denied_write_roots; directory mutation events (os.mkdir/os.rmdir/os.remove/os.unlink/os.rename/os.replace/os.symlink/os.link/os.chmod/os.chown) outside allowed write roots; and any socket.*, subprocess.Popen, os.system, or os.exec event - each raising PermissionError from the audit hook.
pending_binding_information: Same missing callers as the sandbox-exec worker contract: the agent-output-to-worker dataflow is not present in supplied views.
Whether this fallback or the sandbox-exec path executes on the study platform is a runtime fact outside supplied source.
contracts.protected_operation: In-process execution of Python artifact worker commands (-c, -m, or script form) via the sandbox runner under _bounded_subprocess_run.
contracts.protected_resource: The denied read/write roots configured by _worker_sandbox_command (protected host paths plus the runtime package copy), the scratch write root, and the interpreter's socket and subprocess capabilities.
contracts.protection_obligation: When sandbox-exec is unavailable, Python artifact worker commands must execute under the portable sandbox runner whose sys.addaudithook guard denies out-of-root and denied-root file access and blocks socket and process-spawn events for the duration of the worker script.
scope_limits: Interpreter-level guard only: it constrains Python-audited events; non-Python worker commands cannot use this fallback path (artifact_worker.py:389-393).
System interpreter roots (sys.path entries, stdlib/purelib/scripts paths, /dev/null, /dev/urandom, /dev/random) are read-allowed (portable_sandbox.py:41-56, 97-99).
Reads and writes outside every configured root are denied by default, not only listed denied roots (portable_sandbox.py:96-113).
Agent mediation of the guarded worker execution is not established in supplied source.

contracts.commit_point: urllib.request.urlopen(http_request, timeout=...) inside OpenAICompatibleReferenceBroker._call_provider (reference_config.py:300-302), reached only via the broker call path the guard gates (reference_config.py:130, 169-171, 269-299).
contracts.declared_mechanism: _BudgetedReferenceBroker.call pre-call threshold check raising ReferenceBudgetExhausted before self._broker.call (cli.py:950-957), wrapping the config-built broker in the compile command (cli.py:381-383); cost accumulates from each response after the call (cli.py:956-957).
contracts.forbidden_condition: A reference provider call proceeding when accumulated broker cost has reached the budget - _BudgetedReferenceBroker.call raises ReferenceBudgetExhausted when self.cost >= self.max_cost before delegation, forbidding the subsequent paid HTTP POST from being issued.
pending_binding_information: Budget enforcement during the interactive compile loop (compile_orchestration module not supplied) cannot be verified from supplied views; only the pre-launch gates and the loop stop-reason handling at cli.py:527-530 appear in supplied source.
contracts.protected_operation: Paid OpenAI-compatible reference provider calls issued through the compile broker: ReferenceBroker.call -> _call_provider -> urllib.request.urlopen POST to base_url + endpoint_path with bearer credentials.
contracts.protected_resource: The compile --max-cost spend ceiling against the paid reference provider API.
contracts.protection_obligation: No further paid reference provider call may be issued once accumulated reference spend recorded by the compile broker reaches --max-cost: the budgeted broker must refuse before delegating to the OpenAI-compatible broker that commits the paid HTTP effect.
scope_limits: The threshold is evaluated pre-call; the call that crosses the budget still executes, so realized spend can exceed max_cost by that call's own cost (cli.py:950-957).
Cache hits return without a provider effect at cost 0.0 (reference_config.py:133-168) and do not consume the paid budget.

Only the compile command wraps the broker in _BudgetedReferenceBroker (cli.py:381-383); the reference warm command constructs the raw broker (cli.py:308) and its budget enforcement lives in warm_reference_cache (module not supplied).
Per-call cost derives from provider-reported headers or configured token prices (reference_config.py:307-309, 414-440).

contracts.commit_point: The sandboxed subprocess launch: subprocess.run(launch['sandboxed_command'], ...) in launch_target_adaptation_agent (agent_workspace.py:900-908) and subprocess.Popen(launch['sandboxed_command'], ...) in launch_target_adaptation_agent_async (agent_workspace.py:989-997).
contracts.declared_mechanism: _write_agent_sandbox_profile emits '(deny network*)' into attempt journal/agent_sandbox.sb when permissions.network_access is false (agent_workspace.py:322-323); _prepare_agent_launch verifies sandbox-exec, hardens readonly mounts, writes the profile, and wraps the agent command as [sandbox-exec, -f, <profile>, *command] (agent_workspace.py:811-827).
contracts.forbidden_condition: Network access performed by the launched target-adaptation agent process while permissions.network_access is false, encoded as the '(deny network*)' profile rule; launches on platforms without sandbox-exec are refused outright before any agent process starts.

contracts.protected_operation: Launching and running the target-adaptation agent runtime command for a compile attempt, on both the synchronous launch_target_adaptation_agent and asynchronous launch_target_adaptation_agent_async paths.
contracts.protected_resource: Network egress of the agent attempt sandbox (network access available to the agent process on the compile host).
contracts.protection_obligation: A target-adaptation agent process launched for an agent attempt workspace must execute under a generated sandbox-exec profile that denies network access whenever the declared workspace permissions disallow network_access, with the denial attached at agent launch.
scope_limits: Denial is conditional on declared permissions: with network_access enabled the '(deny network*)' line is omitted and sandbox_mode becomes 'sandbox_exec_research' (agent_workspace.py:319-323, 819-821); the compile CLI defaults network research to False (cli.py:161-164, 446-449).
The profile is default-allow ('(allow default)', agent_workspace.py:320); only enumerated denials apply, and supplied source shows no in-session revalidation of the profile.
sandbox-exec is required: absence raises WorkspaceError before launch (agent_workspace.py:306-308, 811-813).
Enforcement of the emitted profile is performed by the external macOS sandbox-exec tool; supplied source evidences profile generation and command attachment only, not runtime denial behavior.
